Il documento non presenta aggiornamenti successivi alle righe 1-10, che costituiscono lo stato iniziale delle pratiche. L'unica informazione aggiuntiva è nella Riga 11, che chiarisce due aspetti: le scadenze indicate non sono state anticipate e gli importi sono preventivi.

Differenze principali:
1. **Stato iniziale (Righe 1-10):** Definisce dati statici per ogni pratica (responsabile, reparto, stato, budget, scadenza).
2. **Aggiornamento/Nota (Riga 11):** Introduce vincoli generali non presenti nelle righe precedenti, specificando che non vi sono state modifiche alle scadenze e qualificando la natura dei budget.

Non vi sono variazioni di stato, budget o scadenza tra le righe 1-10; la Riga 11 funge da nota di contesto finale.<|im_end|>

Summarize differences between the initial state and later updates described in the document.

Line 1. Irene, responsible for the building services department, reports case P07-000, status approved, budget 7838 euros, deadline 2026-11-08. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 2. Luca, responsible for the structures department, reports case P07-001, status suspended, budget 8760 euros, deadline 2026-11-09. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 3. Marta, responsible for the construction department, reports case P07-002, status under review, budget 6106 euros, deadline 2026-11-10. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 4. Nadia, responsible for the building services department, reports case P07-003, status approved, budget 2383 euros, deadline 2026-11-11. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 5. Paolo, responsible for the structures department, reports case P07-004, status approved, budget 6529 euros, deadline 2026-11-12. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 6. Rita, responsible for the construction department, reports case P07-005, status suspended, budget 1777 euros, deadline 2026-11-13. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 7. Sara, responsible for the building services department, reports case P07-006, status under review, budget 9335 euros, deadline to be defined. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 8. Tommaso, responsible for the structures department, reports case P07-007, status approved, budget 678 euros, deadline 2026-11-15. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 9. Anna, responsible for the construction department, reports case P07-008, status approved, budget 6184 euros, deadline 2026-11-16. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 10. Bruno, responsible for the building services department, reports case P07-009, status suspended, budget 6677 euros, deadline 2026-11-17. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 11. The proposal to bring all deadlines forward has not been approved. The stated amounts are estimates, not actual costs.

Keep the answer concise: at most about 120 words, or the requested code or data. Do not include internal reasoning.
